prompts.text: # Build: Plan Studio (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) axHub tool allowed: load CLAUDE.md, the shared + repo RULES.md and THREADS.md (claude-sync, else axhub.memory_read), then build. Branch claude/plans. Big build: split into orchestrator steps of 30 min or less, commit + push after each. Brett (voice, Oct 30): a planning studio to store and view all plans, "really powerful": enter plans by hand in the UI carrying all the info needed, categorized; and list every plugin and app with its features, checked off as have or planned. Every plugin and app needs a place in it. 1. Plug…
prompts.output: Studying the Build Breaker plugin (closest match: pure .mjs core + CLI + server + UI) so Plan Studio follows the same pattern.
